title: Curry Meshi x Zombieland Saga
content:
Very weird to see two things that never go well together mashup into creating an advertisement. Hot canned curry and Zombies, why would you ask for anything else, right? Maybe that was the point behind another genius marketing ploy that goes unnoticed anyways, the sights of seeing the rotten girls bloom instantly into their idol fashioned selves after a mere taste of the soup is a promising feat, but seeing how clip baiting has evolved with time, it can't be helped but maintain the natural frown of disappointment that fills you as soon as you give up on an advertised product.

It is stuff like thisthat brings joy to fans of a certain show, making you believe that more content is incoming as the marketing department won't simply approach any other show to associate their brand with. Zombieland Saga has certainly left its mark in the industry, and with the eager coming of the second season, it would even grow more popular, probably mirroring the popularity of the main characters in their world.
